svg.text: Voya | D0 Data-Flow Diagram A: Contribute an Itinerary
Goal: Voya helps budget-conscious travelers commit to a trip with confidence by turning real travelers' day-by-day
itineraries and reported spending into transparent, month-specific cost breakdowns they can remix into their own plans.
Timing budget: submit to confirmation <= 2 s (team assumption; Week 4 sets no limit). Invalid input is not passed on:
C3 returns 422 field errors to C1 (see I4). Stored rows are what Flow B reads later.
Process step done by a component we build (C#)
Data in motion: text = the data and its form at that point
